name: Twilio SMS & Voice
description: Send SMS, make voice calls, and build 2FA flows with the Twilio API.
postInstallNotes:
1. Phone numbers must be E.164 format (e.g. `+15551234567`).
2. In trial mode, you can only send to verified numbers. Upgrade for production use.
3. Use `sendOtp` to implement 2FA — store the OTP in Redis with a 5-minute TTL for verification.
